## Professional Summary

I identify problems, simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary work, and build practical solutions. With 14+ years in complex, high-reliability manufacturing (Motorola, Samsung, Huawei, Sony, Alcatel), I bridge Quality, Engineering, and Production on the plant floor. Certified Auditor for ISO 9001 · 14001 · 45001, applying practical Lean tools (line balancing, standard work, VSM) and building custom digital tools to resolve bottlenecks, lower costs, and secure Zero-Defect reliability.

---

## Core Competencies (4 Demonstrated Pillars)

- **Problem Solving**: Root Cause Analysis (RCA - 5 Whys, 8D, Ishikawa), Closed-Loop CAPA, Failure Analysis, Zero Defect mindset, Data Analysis & Diagnostics.
- **Process Improvement**: Line Balancing (+17% prod achieved), Standard Work & Ergonomics, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kaizen & Workplace Optimization.
- **Quality Systems**: ISO 9001 · 14001 · 45001 (Active Integrated Internal Auditor), APQP & Control Plans, PFMEA / DFMEA, Metrology & ISO 17025 (Calibration & Traceability).
- **Digital Solutions & Applied AI**: Custom Web Apps for Operations (PCB Defect Recorder, ISO Compliance Analyzer), Applied AI for Operations, Workflow Automation, Zero Paperwork & Bureaucracy Reduction.
- **Languages**: Spanish (Native), English (B2 | Professional Working Proficiency), Portuguese (Basic / Relocation to Brazil).

## What I Have Improved (Problem → Action → Measurable Impact)

- **+17% Production Increase**: Delivered on Alcatel 4007 mobile line through Lean assembly-line rebalancing and ergonomic workstation optimization, simultaneously exceeding First Pass Yield targets.
- **+10% Planned Production Exceeded**: Delivered on Alcatel 4015 through tactical process-flow optimization, maintaining zero catastrophic defects.
- **-3 Operator Roles Reallocated**: Optimized labor efficiency on Samsung microwave line through Lean line rebalancing, lowering manufacturing costs without compromising reliability.
- **-2 Days Onboarding Time Cut**: Designed and facilitated a peer-to-peer 1-on-1 cross-shift training program for new product launches, accelerating skill acquisition.
- **Closed-Loop CAPA Success**: Eliminated recurrence of critical defects across multiple high-tech electronic manufacturing lines.
- **5+ Global Brands Compliance**: Ensured quality and process standards for Motorola, Samsung, Huawei, Sony, and Alcatel on the plant floor.

## Professional Experience

### Grupo BGH — Quality Management & Continuous Improvement
*May 2025 – Present | Full-time | On-site | Tierra del Fuego, Argentina*
- Leading failure analysis and root-cause investigations across 2–3 active production lines to ensure a zero-defect mindset.
- Designing and implementing closed-loop Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with tracked outcomes.
- Managing control and traceability of critical components throughout production flow.
- Coordinating with international suppliers (Asia) for component quality compliance and non-conformity resolution.

### Grupo BGH — Integrated ISO Auditor (ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001)
*October 2022 – Present | Part-time / Parallel Function*
- Conducting 2–4 annual integrated internal audits across the plant.
- Ensuring compliance with customer expectations (ISO 9001), environmental regulations (ISO 14001), and occupational safety standards (ISO 45001).

### Grupo BGH — Senior Process Engineer
*August 2019 – February 2024*
- Designed complete process flow and applied Statistical Process Control (SPC) for a multi-product manufacturing line.
- Facilitated technical training workshops on Lean and critical manufacturing standards.
- Performed process failure analysis to prevent catastrophic deviations.

### Grupo BGH — Metrology & Engineering Laboratory Specialist
*February 2017 – August 2019*
- Executed high-precision calibrations for 50–100 instruments annually under ISO 17025 principles.
- Ensured uninterrupted metrological traceability for RF (Radio Frequency) generators, GPS simulators, and Hi-Pot safety testers.

### Grupo BGH — Process Engineer — Mobile Business Unit (Global Brands)
*March 2014 – February 2017*
- Led manufacturing launch of Alcatel brand; engineered phone assembly lines for Motorola, Huawei, ZTE, Sony, and Alcatel.
- Delivered +17% productivity increase on Alcatel 4007; applied APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, and line balancing.
- Coordinated with overseas suppliers in China for incoming component quality compliance.

### Grupo BGH — NPI Quality Analyst (New Product Introduction)
*May 2012 – February 2014*
- Quality assurance across 11–15 NPI launches under ISO 9001 and ISO/TS 16949 standards.
- Authored inspection instructions, control plans, and participated in DFMEA/PFMEA development.
